mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id , r.user_id , r.visit_date , r.reservation_type , r.status , r.reservation_amount , f.reservation_cancel_deadline_hours AS cancel_deadline_hours , fd.entry_start_time FROM reservations r JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = r.fair_id JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = r.fair_id AND fd.operation_date = r.visit_date WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE OF r
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_histories ( reservation_id , action_type , before_data , after_data , changed_by , actor_type , is_admin_action , change_reason , created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId} , 'RESERVATION_CANCELED' , JSON_OBJECT('status', #{previousStatus}) , JSON_OBJECT('status', 'CANCELED') , #{changedBy} , 'USER' , FALSE , #{reason} , #{now} )
